mechanism: Foscarnet causes electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and renal impairment that potentiate sildenafil's vasodilatory effects and increase hypotension risk; both agents can prolong QT interval.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely, assess renal function and electrolytes regularly, use sildenafil cautiously at reduced doses, and consider alternative antiviral therapy if possible.
